# TD-4: The app's look follows the team's Figma prototype

- **Date:** 2026-11-15
- **Decided by:** Team 9 (approved by Rafael Amador, project manager)
- **Changes:** Supersedes A-32 (visual design). Prototype screens by Sean (Deliverable 2, Section "Application Prototype", slide 9) are in `spec/05-ui-prototype/`.

## Decision
1. The client's visual design must match the prototype screens in `spec/05-ui-prototype/`: colors (dark green, orange accent, blue for water, warm off-white background), typography, card style, spacing, headers with a subtitle and an initials avatar, and the bottom tab bar with five tabs named **Dashboard, Food & Water, Activities, Social, Account**.
2. Map the existing features onto those five screens (for example: daily summary and UREC check-in/streak on Dashboard; meal and water logging with Today/Week/Month on Food & Water; exercise, smart device and UREC visits on Activities; friends and leaderboards on Social; profile, goals and units, sharing settings, 2FA and log out on Account). The developer dashboard (UC-4) keeps its own screen in the same visual style.
3. The prototype shows layout and style, not new requirements. Where it conflicts with Deliverable 1/2, the deliverables win on behavior:
   - Sign-in stays username + password + TOTP code (with the TD-1 setup and remember-device options), styled like the prototype's sign-in screen. Do not build "Sign in with Microsoft".
   - Water entry keeps the liters/gallons input from the team's LogWater unit; totals may be shown in ml as in the prototype.
   - Elements in the prototype with no matching FR/UC (for example scheduled classes or delete account) are shown only if the app already has the data; otherwise leave them out and list them in ASSUMPTIONS.md.
4. Do not change server behavior or remove any feature to fit the design.

1	// UC-1 "View Daily Summary & Goals" — SD-1 "updated daily summary -> display calories, macros, water progress".
2	// FR-2 (calories), FR-6 (water, low-intake message), steps from FR-4 sync. NFR Safety warnings are listed too.
3	import React from 'react';
4	import { RefreshControl, ScrollView, Text } from 'react-native';
5	import { api } from '../api';
6	import { progress } from '../logic';
7	import { Banner, Card, colors, MaintenanceNotice, ProgressBar, Row, s, Stat } from '../ui';
8	import { useAsync } from '../useAsync';
9	
10	export default function TodayScreen({ refreshKey }: { refreshKey: number }) {
11	  const { data, error, loading, reload } = useAsync(() => api.summary(), [refreshKey]);
12	
13	  if (error?.isMaintenance) return <MaintenanceNotice name="Nutrition & Hydration" />;
14	
15	  return (
16	    <ScrollView refreshControl={<RefreshControl refreshing={loading} onRefresh={reload} />}>
17	      {error ? <Banner kind="error">{error.message}</Banner> : null}
18	      {data ? (
19	        <>
20	          <Text style={[s.h1, { marginBottom: 10 }]}>Today ({data.date})</Text>
21	          {data.messages.map((m) => (
22	            <Banner key={m} kind={m.startsWith('Water goal reached') ? 'good' : 'warn'}>{m}</Banner>
23	          ))}
24	          <Card title="Calories">
25	            <Text style={s.body}>
26	              {data.calories} / {data.calorieGoal} kcal
27	            </Text>
28	            <ProgressBar value={progress(data.calories, data.calorieGoal)} color={data.calories > data.calorieGoal ? colors.warn : colors.primary} />
29	            <Row>
30	              <Stat label="Protein" value={`${data.proteinG} g`} />
31	              <Stat label="Carbs" value={`${data.carbsG} g`} />
32	              <Stat label="Fat" value={`${data.fatG} g`} />
33	              <Stat label="Meals" value={String(data.mealCount)} />
34	            </Row>
35	          </Card>
36	          <Card title="Water">
37	            <Text style={s.body}>
38	              {data.waterLiters.toFixed(2)} L ({data.waterMl} / {data.waterGoalMl} ml)
39	            </Text>
40	            <ProgressBar value={progress(data.waterMl, data.waterGoalMl)} color="#2A8BD8" />
41	            <Text style={s.muted}>
42	              That's {(data.waterMl / data.bottleSizeMl).toFixed(1)} bottles of {data.bottleSizeMl} ml.
43	            </Text>
44	          </Card>
45	          <Card title="Steps">
46	            <Text style={s.body}>
47	              {data.steps} / {data.stepGoal} steps
48	            </Text>
49	            <ProgressBar value={progress(data.steps, data.stepGoal)} color={colors.good} />
50	            <Text style={s.muted}>
51	              {data.latestHeartRate ? `Latest heart rate: ${data.latestHeartRate} bpm` : 'Connect a smart device in Activity to sync steps.'}
52	            </Text>
53	          </Card>
54	        </>
55	      ) : null}
56	    </ScrollView>
57	  );
58	}
